layout_system: Large proof stage, right annotation rail, lower-third caption band, and compact takeaway strip. Evidence must remain readable on mobile.
color_system: Quiet editorial contrast with neutral proof surface, restrained accent color, and no generic gradient, neon grid, cyberpunk, robot, random particles, or fake UI atmosphere.
typography_system: Clear Chinese sans-serif hierarchy with short captions, readable proof labels, and no dense paragraph overlays.
caption_system: Lower-third captions show only the current sentence's core information; long claims move into proof or takeaway modules.
proof_panel_rules: Real screenshot, source crop, terminal/file output, or demo proof occupies the primary visual area and stays large enough for phone reading.
annotation_rail_rules: Annotation rail names source, step, risk, or result; it must never become decoration or pseudo evidence.
background_rules: Background is quiet, premium, low-detail, text-free, and supports foreground evidence without fake official UI or placeholder panels.
motion_language: Meaningful information handoff: proof crop reveal, annotation lock, checklist state change, and source-to-result relay. No random motion.
sfx_language: Subtle voice-safe clicks, locks, and soft sweeps below narration; no music/SFX masking.
cover_rules: Cover is a designed first-frame asset, compact title, center-crop safe, and not a grabbed random frame.
douyin_delivery_strategy: Default output is 16:9 proof master. Optional 9:16 adaptation may place the 16:9 proof panel inside a vertical canvas with separate QA.
